series.name: Letting go of smoking
series.line: A series for the moments a cigarette used to fill

sessions.title: 8 Minutes of Peace
sessions.line: Let everything be as it is for eight minutes.
sessions.starts: Starts with a short welcome, then finding a position where you can let go a little.

sessions.title: Suspended in Light
sessions.line: A slow wave of light through a resting body.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable and letting the body rest.

sessions.title: The Empathic Journey: What Is Yours
sessions.line: Notice which feelings are yours, and which are passing through.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable, then softening from the top of the head down.

sessions.title: The Empathic Journey: Steady Presence
sessions.line: For when you feel everyone's feelings: a steady center to come back to.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable, then softening from the top of the head down.

sessions.title: Quantum Identity
sessions.line: Step toward the self you are becoming, with trust.
sessions.starts: Starts with a short welcome, then a slow breath and the surface beneath you.

sessions.title: Emotional Renewal
sessions.line: For after a heavy stretch: steady ground and a little clarity.
sessions.starts: Starts with settling into a steady position and letting your body arrive.

sessions.title: Deep Confidence Activation
sessions.line: Confidence that grows quietly, one breath at a time.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to a slow, steady breath, then the body settling.

sessions.title: Steady and Alive
sessions.line: Calm energy and steady strength, from the ground up.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable and letting the surface beneath you take your weight.

sessions.title: Settling Back Into the Body
sessions.line: A slow, warm scan from head to feet.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable, then warmth at the top of your head.

sessions.title: Resting in Shared Awareness
sessions.line: Rest in your body, and feel the quiet presence around you.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable and letting the whole body arrive.

sessions.title: The Whole Being
sessions.line: Meet each part of you with openness, and rest as one whole.
sessions.starts: Starts with a slow breath in, then a gentle arrival in the body.

sessions.title: Grounded in Light
sessions.line: Let the ground hold you, and return steady and clear.
sessions.starts: Starts with a moment to arrive, then the surface beneath you holding your weight.

sessions.title: Deep Nervous System Reset
sessions.line: A longer settle, for when two minutes is not enough.
sessions.starts: Starts with a moment to arrive, then finding a comfortable position.

sessions.title: Weightless
sessions.line: A long, slow drift into deep rest.
sessions.starts: Starts with settling in for the night, then a slow inhale and a long exhale.

sessions.title: The Sleep Ritual: Grounded and Safe
sessions.line: Feel the quiet strength beneath you, and let sleep come.
sessions.starts: Starts with “welcome back,” then getting comfortable for the night.

sessions.title: The Sleep Ritual: The Light Within
sessions.line: A soft glow down through the body, and the part of you that knows how to rest.
sessions.starts: Starts with a short welcome, then a breath in through the nose and out through the mouth.

sessions.title: Steady Calm
sessions.line: For when your system needs a calm, steady rhythm again.
sessions.starts: Starts with settling in and a simple intention: let the body feel supported.

sessions.title: Opening Into Abundance
sessions.line: Soften, breathe, and make room for more.
sessions.starts: Starts with an easy breath, then your shoulders and stomach softening.

sessions.title: Quiet Confidence
sessions.line: A long, slow settle, and confidence that needs no effort.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable, then your shoulders, jaw and face softening.

sessions.title: A Deep Start to the Day
sessions.line: The longer morning practice: settle, breathe, and choose how to meet the day.
sessions.starts: Starts with settling into a comfortable position, then a slow breath in and an easy breath out.

sessions.title: Shifting Timelines
sessions.line: Thank the path that brought you here, and step toward what is next.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable, then a gentle breath in and a slow exhale.

sessions.title: The Frequency of Abundance
sessions.line: Settle in, and feel the abundance that is already here.
sessions.starts: Starts with a short welcome, then a breath, as you are.

sessions.title: Drift Into Sleep
sessions.line: A slow light down through the body, then a quiet room to fall asleep in.
sessions.starts: Starts with a short welcome, then lying down and one deep breath.

sessions.title: 5 Minute Morning Clarity
sessions.line: For the first few minutes of the day.
sessions.starts: Starts with a short welcome, then settling in and a few slow breaths.

sessions.title: Set Down What You Carry
sessions.line: For a weight you have been carrying.
sessions.starts: Starts with a long breath, then names a weight you may be carrying.

sessions.title: Three Minute Reset
sessions.line: For a three-minute pause.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to three slow, full breaths.

sessions.title: Quiet the Mind
sessions.line: For when your thoughts keep moving.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to the breath, with no welcome.

sessions.title: Ground Your Mind
sessions.line: For when your head is louder than your feet.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to a breath, then the weight of your body and feet.

sessions.title: Ground Into Your Body
sessions.line: For when you feel scattered and want to land.
sessions.starts: Starts with a breath, then your shoulders and jaw letting go.

sessions.title: Evening Settle
sessions.line: For the end of a long day.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to a breath, then the day's weight lowering.

sessions.title: Let the Day Close
sessions.line: For when the day is still running in your head.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable, then your shoulders, jaw and face softening.

sessions.title: Morning Calm, Focused Activation
sessions.line: For a calm, focused start.
sessions.starts: Starts with your posture, then a breath held briefly and released.

sessions.title: 5 Minute Calm
sessions.line: For a pause in the middle of the day.
sessions.starts: Starts with a short welcome, then your shoulders and jaw.

sessions.title: Nervous System Reset
sessions.line: For when you have about two minutes.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to a breath and your shoulders lowering.

sessions.title: A Five-Minute Reset
sessions.line: For the middle of a full day.
sessions.starts: Starts with one slow breath. A few words to say to yourself come near the end.

sessions.title: Letting Love In
sessions.line: For when you need to feel loved, starting with yourself.
sessions.starts: Starts with a breath, as you are. A few words to say to yourself come along the way.

sessions.title: Letting Stress Leave Your Body
sessions.line: For when the day is still sitting in your shoulders.
sessions.starts: Starts with finding a place to rest. Lying down is welcome.

sessions.title: Tapping Into Your Creative Energy
sessions.line: For the minute before you start making something.
sessions.starts: Starts with the weight of your body, then brings to mind the work you make.

sessions.title: For Someone You Love and Miss
sessions.line: For when you miss someone and want to feel close to them.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to the breath and warmth in your chest, then brings someone to mind.

sessions.title: The Quantum Reset
sessions.line: For evenings when you want to put the day's self down and start fresh.
sessions.starts: A longer practice. Starts with finding a position where you can be still.

sessions.title: Open to Receive
sessions.line: For when some part of you is still braced against having more.
sessions.starts: Starts with your body arriving and one slow, full breath.

sessions.title: When Your Mind Won't Stop at Bedtime
sessions.line: Close the day's open tabs and let the list wait for morning.
sessions.starts: Starts by naming the busy mind, then lets it rest.

sessions.title: Two Minutes Between Things
sessions.line: One slow reset between meetings or errands.
sessions.starts: Goes straight to one slow breath and your feet on the floor.

sessions.title: When You Wake Up Already Tense
sessions.line: For mornings when the tightness gets there before the day does.
sessions.starts: Starts with your eyes open, noticing the tightness in your chest.

sessions.title: Still Enough to Sleep
sessions.line: Let the day be done, and sink into sleep.
sessions.starts: Starts in bed, with one full breath and the weight of your body.

sessions.title: Connecting to Abundance and Prosperity
sessions.line: Feel connected to everything, and open your hands to what is coming.
sessions.starts: Starts with letting whatever is under you hold your weight.

sessions.title: The Frequency of Enough
sessions.line: When the day was all measuring, feel that you have done enough.
sessions.starts: Starts with a look back at your day, then the breath.

sessions.title: Before You Check Anything
sessions.line: The first minutes of the day, before anything else gets in.
sessions.starts: Starts as you wake, before you reach for your phone.

sessions.title: Before You Say Yes
sessions.line: Someone asks. One breath before you answer.
sessions.starts: Starts in the moment someone asks you for something.

sessions.title: Before the Week Starts
sessions.line: Sunday evening, when the week lands in your chest: name each thing, set the weight down.
sessions.starts: Starts on Sunday evening, with one long breath.

sessions.title: The Empowerment Practice
sessions.line: Remember that you are powerful: feet, breath, heat in the chest, and the fire that is already yours.
sessions.starts: Starts sitting or standing steady, with a deep breath.

sessions.title: The Abundance Practice
sessions.line: Feel abundance as something already here: warmth in the chest, one thing you have, the sense of enough.
sessions.starts: Starts with getting comfortable and feeling held.

sessions.title: After a Tense Conversation
sessions.line: Let a tense conversation settle: jaw, shoulders, hands, feet on the ground.
sessions.starts: Starts with the conversation that has ended, then a deep breath.

sessions.title: The Pause Before Asking
sessions.line: Name a price for your work, rehearse a real offer, and let the sentence end.
sessions.starts: Starts with your hands, then asks you to say your price out loud.

sessions.title: Stress Without the Cigarette
sessions.line: Choose one small thing to try before reaching for a cigarette.
sessions.starts: Starts with your breathing as it is, then one small thing to try instead.

sessions.title: A New Small Ritual
sessions.line: Choose one small action for a familiar pause in your day.
sessions.starts: Starts slowly, with where your body meets the chair or floor.

sessions.title: When the Urge Arrives
sessions.line: Notice what is here, then choose one helpful next step.
sessions.starts: Starts with the urge itself, at your own pace. You can pause or move any time.

sessions.title: Remembering Your Reason
sessions.line: Reconnect with your own reason for wanting to stop smoking.
sessions.starts: Starts with why you are here: your own reason to stop smoking.

sessions.title: This Precious Life
sessions.line: An ordinary moment, and life here in this breath.
sessions.starts: Starts with the support beneath you and your breathing as it is.

sessions.title: Let Them Think What They Think
sessions.line: Room to be yourself without carrying every opinion.
sessions.starts: Starts with your breathing, then whose opinion you have been carrying.

sessions.title: A Soft Place to Land
sessions.line: A warm voice. A little sound. Nothing to do for a while.
sessions.starts: Starts with where your body is held, then the breath and your hands.

sessions.title: Still Enough to Listen
sessions.line: Nine quiet minutes to be still and notice your breath.
sessions.starts: Starts with being still, then listening for your heartbeat.
